notes: Manually read every eligible production file, including api.ts and the otherwise separate cli-metadata.ts entrypoint, plus package and manifest metadata. Source scope includes erased types; this is not a packaged-artifact audit.

All local imports stay within extensions/policy. No additional plugin-owned or shared shipped source lies outside the plugin root; SDK facade implementations and separately installed json5/commander dependencies are not recursively audited.
api.registerCli is the only OpenClawPluginApi member consumed. The definePluginEntry contract supplies the register callback API. There are no hook registrations or PluginRuntime handles.

HealthCheckContext/HealthRepairContext, their cfg/runtime fields, policy evidence objects, optional PolicyDoctorRegistrationHost and SDK function return values are not OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime. Configuration gateway/channel/tool/sandbox members do not create runtime-member findings.
defaultRuntime is imported as cliRuntime and its error member is called; toolPolicy exported-object methods are called. These are SDK-export call dependencies, not host-runtime members.

registerPluginHealthCheck directly aliases SDK registerHealthCheck; the local registerHealthCheck fallback resolves to it when the optional custom host is absent. Its direct call is recorded, with no API-member attributed to the custom host.

Original SDK exports are preserved for asBoolean/readBoolean, normalizeOptionalString/readString, normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty/normalizePolicyChannelId and hasNonEmptyString/nonEmptyString. Local helper wrappers and local policy barrels do not forward SDK-export provenance.

coerceSecretRef has a runtime call and an explicit imported typeof type use; its export and module are mixed. Health and routing modules each contain runtime and explicit type import sites. Import/type-import classifications follow syntax.

Repository-wide caller searches establish the six individual test-helper exclusions. The register.test-harness.ts helper was read to verify fixture/setup purpose; its SDK imports are excluded with its test-only scope.

Only cliCommands.name and commandAliases.name declare manifest contract identities. Categories, activation/configuration fields and command alias kind describe metadata, not additional contract identities.
Evidence includes every SDK import site and representative call/type-reference occurrences. Reviewed-file findingCount counts distinct finding keys evidenced in that file, not occurrences.
